description_expanded: 30A ESCAPES presents… “Wave N Sea” ***, Your personal slice of coastal luxury. Nestled in the prestigious, gated Water’s Edge community in Seacrest Beach, this 4-bedroom, 3-bathroom retreat comfortably sleeps 12 and is thoughtfully designed to blend laid-back beach living with elevated comfort. Just steps from private beach access, this home is a dream for families and friends seeking sunshine, serenity, and style. Whether you’re sipping wine on the balcony with Gulf breezes, sunbathing beside your private heated pool, or biking to nearby Rosemary or Alys Beach, every moment at “Wave N Sea” is effortlessly unforgettable. Learn more below…👇*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Luxury Gated Community – Located in the exclusive Water’s Edge next to Rosemary BeachPrivate Beach Access – Just steps away via a deeded pathSeasonal Beach Setup Included – 2 chairs & 1 umbrellaPrivate Pool – Seasonally heated with pool loungers & al fresco diningOutdoor Living – Two furnished balconies + spacious pool deck with gas grill4 Bedrooms + 3 Bathrooms – Sleeps up to 12 with stylish and spacious accommodationsChef’s Kitchen – Stainless appliances, bar seating, and dining for 86 Bikes Included – Explore the best of 30A with ease*** LIVING AREA ***On the main level, the open-concept living space invites relaxation with cozy coastal furnishings and direct access to the pool deck. Whether you're enjoying family movie night or gathering after the beach, this space is designed for connection and comfort.Plush sofa and seating for the whole groupLarge flat-screen TV for streaming or moviesDouble doors open to the pool deck for seamless indoor/outdoor living*** KITCHEN & DINING ***Stylish and functional, the kitchen is perfect for whipping up post-beach snacks or full family feasts. Enjoy stainless steel appliances, plenty of prep space, and dining areas made for memory-making.Fully equipped kitchen with stainless steel appliancesBar seating for 4 at the island for casual bites or wine chatsDining table seats 8 for family-style meals and evening games*** OUTDOOR OASIS ***With multiple outdoor living areas to choose from, you’ll love lounging by the private pool, hosting cookouts on the grill, or sipping morning coffee on the breezy balconies. Whether it’s sun-soaked afternoons or star-lit evenings, this outdoor space is made for unforgettable moments.Private pool with sun loungers and outdoor showerAl fresco dining for 6 on the pool deck—perfect for laid-back mealsGas grill for cookouts with your crew2nd Floor Balcony – Furnished for morning coffee or sunset wine3rd Floor Balcony – Private space off the bunk room with views and breezes*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***1st FloorQueen Guest Suite: Two queen beds, flat-screen TV, and en-suite bathroom with single vanity and walk-in shower2nd FloorQueen Guest Suite: Queen bed, flat-screen TV, and balcony accessGuest Bathroom: Shared hall bath with single vanity and walk-in showerPrimary King Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV, balcony access, and spa-style en-suite with dual vanities, soaking tub, and walk-in showerLaundry Room: Full-size washer and dryer3rd FloorBunk Room: Two twin-over-full bunk beds, flat-screen TV, private balcony access*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Tucked inside the gated Water’s Edge community, “Wave N Sea” is perfectly situated just steps from the sand and moments from 30A’s most beloved destinations.Steps to private beach access – No crowded boardwalks here6-minute walk to Rosemary Beach – Boutiques, dining, and town charm13-minute walk to Alys Beach – Renowned architecture and eventsClose to Peddler’s Pavilion – Seasonal live music and casual eatsBike-friendly paths throughout the area—ride your way to adventure*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included in our quotes. It can be purchased during the reservation process or obtained independentlyWe do NOT accept wire transfers for paymentPool heated seasonally (Sept. 1 - April 30)Seasonal Beach Chair Service Included - 2 Chairs & 1 Umbrella (March 6-October 31)Waiver required to get access to the 6 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A EscapesLSVs are not allowed in Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, or Alys Beach*** YOUR STAY – OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE ***
